text:
Maya: Heads-up — three customers are rolling into the onboarding lane next week. Thinking short pop-up enablement clinics (30m) by persona: integrators, PMs, platform. Who can host and which slot works? Proposed slots: Tue 9:00a PT, Wed 4:00p CET, Thu 10:00a SGT. I can draft the agenda and follow up with invites and a 2‑question prep ask.

scheduler-bot: Poll created: https://calendar.redwood.com/polls/5209991234 (select all that you can cover). Auto-create invites after final RSVP.

Ravi: I can take Tue 9:00a PT (integrators). Will prepare a migration checklist + demo snippet.

Sam: Wed 4:00p CET works for me. I'll focus on product/PM use cases & prompt evaluation tips.

Elena: Thu 10:00a SGT ok. Can we include a 5-minute live Q&A and a 2-slide appendix on config best practices? Also confirm customer list (AstraWave, LumaClinic, Tidewell).

Maya: Nice. Draft agenda (30m):
```
- 0–3m: Welcome + goals
- 3–12m: Top migration pitfalls (Ravi)
- 12–20m: Product patterns + prompt tuning (Sam)
- 20–25m: Config & infra checklist (Elena)
- 25–30m: Live Q&A
```
Prep asks for customers: 1) a short sample prompt set (5), 2) expected concurrent users/traffic, 3) any blocked ports or private networking notes. I'll ping CSMs for that.

Ravi: +1 to the agenda. I'll attach a 1-page migration runbook to the invite. (Link: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/migration-quickstart)

Sam: Can we record and auto-drop transcript into the customer record? If yes I'll add timestamps for the recording.

scheduler-bot: Invites queued. Recording enabled by default. Calendar invites will include the recording link + feedback form: https://forms.redwood.com/enablement-feedback

Maya: Perfect — I'll post the finalized invites and a short facilitator checklist (5 bullets) in #cs-prep channel later today. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
